title: Mirabel and the Signal
author: Xanthe Almeida
blurb: Rosalind Eriksen, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
